segments.name: Investments in the medical cannabis sector
segments.description: Produces, manufactures and distributes pharmaceutical-grade cannabis and cannabis-based products for medical use to patients in Israel and target markets.
segments.evidence: Investments in the medical cannabis sector: Canndoc, Cannolam, Pharmazone and other investments as described in Note 8.

segments.name: Investments in portfolio companies in the biomed sector
segments.description: Holds strategic investments in life sciences and medical innovation companies, measured at fair value through profit or loss.
segments.evidence: Investments in portfolio companies in the biomed sector: the Company has investments in XTL, Cavnox and Fore.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from selling pharmaceutical-grade cannabis and cannabis-based products, distributed to patients through licensed retail pharmacies and its own pharmacy chain.
revenueModel.evidence: In Israel, we distribute our products through licensed retail pharmacy locations, where patients may fill their prescriptions on site or have our products delivered directly to their residence.

changes.text: In July 2024, the company acquired Leon Pharm, a leading Israel-based pharmacy chain specializing in dispensing medical cannabis.
changes.evidence: In July 2024, we completed the purchase of Leon Pharm Ltd. ("Leon Pharm"), a leading, Israel-based pharmacy chain located in major cities throughout Israel specializing in dispensing medical cannabis in Israel, by way of a share purchase of all of the issued and outstanding share capital of Leon Pharm.
